_about: Practice sentences per noun and role (subject, object, preposition, possession), gated by fil.nouns.sentence_gate and read by a blind reviewer.

example.en: The owner of the house is generous.
The guest thanked the owner of the house.
I greeted the owner of the house.
The house owner's car is new.

critique.note: Minor: standard Bosnian treats 'auto' as masculine — 'Auto vlasnika kuće je nov' preferable.

example.en: The day is beautiful.
We spent the day in the house.
We went out on a sunny day.
I returned at the end of the day.
example.bs: Vratio sam se na kraju dana.

example.en: The earth is wide.
The farmer watered the land.
The child sat on the ground.
The colour of the earth is red.
The people travelled at night.
The man visited a generous people.
The stranger lived with the people.
I learned the language of the people.
The signs are clear.
The student memorised the verse.
I reflected on the signs.
I memorised the numbers of the verses.
A messenger came from the king.
The king sent a messenger.
I handed the letter to the messenger.
I saw the horse of the king's messenger.
The pain finally disappeared.

critique.note: Minor: EN 'torment/suffering' would render عَذَاب more exactly than 'pain'.

example.en: The medicine eased the pain.

critique.note: عَذَاب means torment/suffering, not ordinary pain a medicine eases (that is أَلَم); unnatural. Fix e.g. تَحَمَّلَ الْمَرِيضُ الْعَذَابَ بِصَبْرٍ / The patient bore the suffering patiently / Bolesnik je strpljivo podnosio muku.

example.en: The prisoner was saved from the punishment.
The duration of the punishment is short.
The prisoner bore the punishment patiently.

critique.note: Correct: object accusative, natural; bs imperfective podnosio fits.

example.en: The sky is clear.
The child drew the sky.
The sparrow flies in the sky.
The colour of the sky is blue.
The soul loves rest.
Sleep rests the soul.
Self-confidence is important.
The rest of the soul is important.

critique.note: EN 'The rest of the soul' reads as 'the remainder of the soul'. Fix EN: 'Peace of mind (rest of the soul) is important.'

example.en: Peace of the soul is important.

critique.note: Correct iḍāfa, genitive noun, feminine agreement; translations natural.

example.en: Something fell from the window.
I bought something beautiful.
I thought about something.
I asked about the price of something.
The book is on the table.
The girl read the book.
I found the picture in the book.
The cover of the book is red.
The truth is clear.
The witness told the truth.
The lawyer defended the truth.
The voice of truth is strong.
The people met in the market.
example.bs: Ljudi su se okupili na pijaci.

example.en: The doctor helped the people.
The teacher spoke to the people.
I heard the people's talk.
The believer is truthful.
The neighbours respected the believer.
The imam prayed with the believers.
The believer's heart is compassionate.
Good spreads quickly.
The man did good.
The father called his son to good.
example.bs: Otac je pozvao sina na dobro.

example.en: The path of good is clear.
The road is long.
The traveller took the road.
The man walked on the road.
We reached the end of the road.
The matter is easy.
The judge understood the matter.
The brothers consulted on the matter.
example.bs: Braća su se savjetovala o stvari.

example.en: I learned the truth of the matter.
The disbeliever does not pray.
The preacher invited the disbeliever kindly.
The scholar spoke with the disbeliever.
The disbeliever's heart changed.
The garden is green.
The gardener watered the garden.
The children played in the garden.
example.bs: Djeca su se igrala u bašči.

example.en: The trees of the garden are tall.
The fire flared up.
The scout lit the fire.
The mother cooked on the fire.
The warmth of the fire is gentle.
The heart beats.
The doctor examined the heart.
I felt joy in the heart.
The doctor heard the beat of the heart.
The slave was freed.
The merchant freed the slave.
The man treated the servant well.
example.bs: Čovjek je bio dobar prema robu.

example.en: The servant's hand got tired.
The wrongdoer was punished.
The judge punished the wrongdoer.
The poor man complained about the wrongdoer.
The wrongdoer's injustice ended.
The family arrived at the airport.
The student visited the family.
The traveller longed for the family.
The family home is warm.
The hand is clean.
The children washed the hands.

critique.note: Unnatural: Arabic says washing 'the hands' without possessor; use غَسَلَ الْأَطْفَالُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ / The children washed their hands / Djeca su oprala ruke (gloss أَيْدِيَهُمْ = their hands).

example.en: The man wrote by hand.
The fingers of the hand are five.

critique.note: Numeral predicate خَمْسَةٌ with أَصَابِع (إِصْبَع mostly feminine → خَمْسٌ) is doubtful; EN 'The fingers of the hand are five' unnatural and BS restructured ('Ruka ima pet prstiju') with gloss 'su pet' not matching. Replace, e.g. أَصَابِعُ الْيَدِ نَظِيفَةٌ / The fingers of the hand are clean / Prsti ruke su čisti.

example.en: The child drew a hand.

critique.note: Correct indefinite accusative object; fine.

example.en: The fingers of the hand are clean.

critique.note: Correct iḍāfa; broken plural takes fem. sg. predicate نظيفة; fine.

example.en: The tree is tall.
The farmer planted a tree.
The sparrow sat on the tree.
We sat under the branches of the tree.
The water is cold.
The child drank the water.
The duck swims in the water.
The sound of the water is calm.
The mountain is high.
The man climbed the mountain.
The farmer came down from the mountain.
The snow is on the top of the mountain.
The sea is calm.
The ship crossed the sea.
We swim in the sea.
The water of the sea is salty.
The sun rose.
The children saw the sun.
Grandfather sat in the sun.
The light of the sun is strong.
The moon appeared.
We saw the moon.
The child looked at the moon.
The light of the moon is beautiful.
Figs are delicious.
I ate the figs.
I filled the basket with figs.
The taste of figs is sweet.
Olives are beneficial.
The farmer picked the olives.
I ate the bread with olives.
Olive oil is healthy.
The date palms are tall.
The farmer planted the date palms.
We picked dates from the palms.
The fruit of the palms is sweet.
The grapes are ripe.
The mother bought grapes.
They made the juice from the grapes.
The colour of the grapes is green.
A cow is eating the grass.
The farmer bought a cow.
The farmer passed by some cows.
We heard the sound of cows.
The merchants travelled on camels.
The Bedouin drank camel milk.
The camels eat the grass.

critique.note: Correct: collective إبل takes feminine verb تأكل; translations accurate.

example.en: The Bedouin watered the camels.

critique.note: Correct accusative object; natural translations.

example.en: The eye turned red.
The doctor examined the eye.
The dust got into the eye.
The colour of the eye is black.
The house is large.
The girl cleaned the house.
The children stayed in the house.
The father opened the door of the house.
The ship set sail.
The carpenter built a ship.
The passengers got off the ship.
The owner of the ship is rich.
The rivers are long.
The travellers crossed a river.

critique.note: نَهَر vowelling is the valid Quranic variant; MSA usually نَهْر — acceptable since it matches the lemma.

example.en: The man caught fish from a river.
example.bs: Čovjek je ulovio ribu iz rijeke.

critique.note: Same: نَهَر variant acceptable.

example.en: The water of the rivers is sweet.

critique.note: EN 'sweet' for عَذْب misleads (sugar); use 'The water of the rivers is fresh' (gloss عَذْبٌ = fresh). BS 'slatka' is fine.

example.en: The water of the rivers is fresh.

critique.note: Correct iḍāfa with plural أنهار; slatka voda is idiomatic Bosnian for fresh water.

example.en: The door opened.
The guard locked the door.

critique.note: أَغْلَقَ = closed, not locked (locked = أَقْفَلَ). Fix EN 'The guard closed the door', BS 'Čuvar je zatvorio vrata', gloss closed|zatvorio je.

example.en: The cat went out through the door.
The colour of the door is white.
The guard closed the door.

critique.note: Correct accusative object; fine.

example.en: The star glittered.
The astronomer saw a star.
We looked at the stars.
The light of the star is weak.
The tongue tastes the food.
The doctor examined the tongue.
I felt pain in the tongue.
The movement of the tongue is quick.
The leg is sound.
The doctor treated the leg.
The child stood on one leg.
example.bs: Dijete je stajalo na jednoj nozi.

example.en: The pain of the leg is severe.
The stick broke.
The farmer carried the staff.
Grandfather walked with the stick.
The length of the stick is a metre.
The dog barked.
The child fed the dog.
The child was afraid of the dog.
The dog's voice is strong.
Pomegranates are red.
I made juice from the pomegranates.
The mother peeled the pomegranates.

critique.note: Correct accusative; plural 'narove' matches collective meaning.

example.en: The taste of pomegranates is sour.

critique.note: Correct iḍāfa: طَعْمُ nominative mubtada', الرُّمَّانِ genitive possessor, حَامِضٌ nominative indefinite khabar, masculine singular agreeing with طَعْم. Collective rendered as plural in both languages, consistently. Word gloss 'of the pomegranates' vs. generic 'pomegranates' in the sentence is acceptable. Everyday content.

example.en: The milk is fresh.
The child drank the milk.
Grandmother made the cheese from the milk.
example.bs: Baka je napravila sir od mlijeka.

example.en: The colour of the milk is white.
The birds twittered.

critique.note: Correct: verb-initial masculine singular غرّدَ with collective subject. Optionally 'chirped/sang' instead of 'twittered'.

example.en: The child fed the birds.

critique.note: Correct accusative object; translations accurate.

example.en: The hunter looked at the birds.

critique.note: Correct genitive after إلى; translations natural.

example.en: The birds' feathers are colourful.

critique.note: Correct iḍāfa; ملوّنٌ agrees with masculine collective ريش. Minor: gloss 'colored' vs sentence 'colourful' spelling.

example.en: Mercy is beautiful.
The mother loves mercy.
The teacher spoke about mercy.
The trace of mercy is clear.
The wage is small.

critique.note: en says 'wage(s)' but bs uses 'nagrada' (reward); make them agree: bs 'plata/plaća' for wage, or en 'reward' (e.g. 'Plata je mala.')

example.en: The worker took a wage.

critique.note: en says 'wage(s)' but bs uses 'nagrada' (reward); make them agree: bs 'plata/plaća' for wage, or en 'reward' (e.g. 'Radnik je uzeo platu.')

example.en: The worker was glad about the wages.

critique.note: en says 'wage(s)' but bs uses 'nagrada' (reward); make them agree: bs 'plata/plaća' for wage, or en 'reward' (e.g. 'Radnik se obradovao platama.')

example.en: The value of the wage is great.

critique.note: en says 'wage(s)' but bs uses 'nagrada' (reward); make them agree: bs 'plata/plaća' for wage, or en 'reward' (e.g. 'Vrijednost plate je velika.')

example.en: The wage is small.
The worker took a wage.
The worker was glad about the wages.

critique.note: Uses the broken plural الْأُجُور instead of the studied noun أَجْر; 'Radnik se obradovao platama' (one worker, plural wages) is unnatural in Bosnian. Fix: فَرِحَ الْعَامِلُ بِالْأَجْرِ / 'The worker was glad about the wage.' / 'Radnik se obradovao plati.'

example.en: The value of the wage is great.
The worker was glad about the wage.
Knowledge is light.
The student sought knowledge.
The child was glad about the knowledge.
The science book is new.
Religion is important to people.
The student studied religion.
The child asked about religion.
The history of religion is long.
The saying is clear.
The student wrote a beautiful saying.
The man thought about the saying.
The author of the saying is known.
The example is clear.
The teacher gave an example.
The student understood the lesson through examples.
example.bs: Učenik je razumio lekciju kroz primjere.

example.en: The meaning of the proverb is easy.
An angel does not eat.
The teacher mentioned an angel in the lesson.
example.bs: Učitelj je spomenuo meleka u lekciji.

example.en: I read a story about the angels.
The angel's name is beautiful.
Money does not buy happiness.
The man gave the money to the poor.
The man bought a house with a lot of money.
example.bs: Čovjek je kupio kuću za mnogo novca.

example.en: The owner of the wealth is generous.
The child's guardian attended.
The teacher thanked the student's guardian.
The teacher spoke with the guardians.
The guardian's name is written.
Guidance is clear.
The man sought guidance.
The student was glad of the guidance.
The road of guidance is clear.
A mother's kindness is great.
The student remembered the teacher's kindness.
The student succeeded thanks to his mother.
People of virtue are generous.
The night is long.
The poet loved the night.
The child slept at night.
The end of the night is calm.
Prayer time is near.
The man waited for the prayer in the mosque.
example.bs: Čovjek je čekao namaz u džamiji.

example.en: The father went to the prayer.
The time of prayer is near.
The sons came with their father.

critique.note: Sentence uses الْبَنُونَ (plural of ابْن, which has its own entry), not the diminutive بُنَيّ; use بُنَيّ itself, e.g. 'نَامَ بُنَيُّ الْجَارِ' (The neighbour's little son slept)

example.en: The grandfather visited the sons.

critique.note: Uses الْبَنِينَ (plural of ابْن), not the diminutive بُنَيّ; rewrite with بُنَيّ, e.g. 'حَمَلَ الْأَبُ بُنَيَّهُ' (The father carried his little son)

example.en: The father sat with the sons.

critique.note: Uses الْبَنِينَ (plural of ابْن), not بُنَيّ; rewrite, e.g. 'جَلَسَ الْأَبُ مَعَ بُنَيِّهِ' (The father sat with his little son)

example.en: The sons' house is near.

critique.note: Uses الْبَنِينَ (plural of ابْن), not بُنَيّ; rewrite, e.g. 'لُعْبَةُ بُنَيِّ الْجَارِ جَمِيلَةٌ' (The neighbour's little son's toy is nice)

example.en: The neighbor's little son fell asleep.
I saw the neighbor's little son.
I played with the neighbor's little son.
example.bs: Igrao sam se s komšijinim sinčićem.

example.en: The neighbor's little son's toy is beautiful.
The companions came to the house.
I visited the companions.
I sat with the companions.
The companions' house is large.
Life is beautiful.
The child loves life.
The man learned from life.
The taste of life is sweet.
Mentioning friends is nice.
The father heard his name mentioned.
example.bs: Otac je čuo spomen svog imena.

example.en: The grandfather was glad to recall the past.
The time of remembrance is calm.
The husband is at work.
The woman waited for the husband.

critique.note: Unnatural: 'waited for THE husband'; use her own husband: 'انْتَظَرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ زَوْجَهَا' / 'The woman waited for her husband.' / 'Žena je čekala svog muža.'

example.en: The woman traveled with the husband.

critique.note: Unnatural 'with THE husband'; use 'سَافَرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا' / 'The woman travelled with her husband.' / 'Žena je putovala sa svojim mužem.'

example.en: The husband's name is long.
The woman thanked her sister's husband.
example.bs: Žena se zahvalila mužu svoje sestre.

example.en: The teacher spoke with the husband and the wife.
example.bs: Učitelj je razgovarao s mužem i ženom.

example.en: The brother is playing in the garden.
The child helped the brother.

critique.note: Unnatural 'helped THE brother'; use 'سَاعَدَ الطِّفْلُ أَخَاهُ' / 'The child helped his brother.' / 'Dijete je pomoglo svom bratu.'

example.en: The child went with the brother.

critique.note: Unnatural 'went with THE brother'; use 'ذَهَبَ الطِّفْلُ مَعَ أَخِيهِ' / 'The child went with his brother.' / 'Dijete je otišlo sa svojim bratom.'

example.en: The brother's house is near.
The man visited a brother of his.
example.bs: Čovjek je posjetio jednog svog brata.

example.en: The child went with the older brother.
example.bs: Dijete je otišlo sa starijim bratom.

example.en: The prophet was generous.
The people loved the prophet.
The child read a story about the prophets.
example.bs: Dijete je pročitalo priču o vjerovjesnicima.

example.en: The prophet's name is written.
The righteous person loves people.
People love the righteous.
The child sat with the righteous.
The righteous man's house is near.
The face is beautiful.
The child washed the face with water.

critique.note: Unnatural 'washed THE face'; use 'غَسَلَ الطِّفْلُ وَجْهَهُ بِالْمَاءِ' / 'The child washed his face with water.' / 'Dijete je opralo lice vodom.'

example.en: The mother looked at the children's faces.
The color of the face is red.
The artist drew a beautiful face.
A person learns every day.
The doctor helped the person.
The student wrote about the human being.
The human mind is amazing.
The proof is clear.
The judge asked for proof.
The judge ruled according to the evidence.
example.bs: Sudija je presudio na osnovu dokaza.

example.en: The strength of the evidence is great.
There is much work today.
The man finished the work.
The father returned from work.
The result of the work is good.
The resurrection is the topic of the lesson.
The child asked about the resurrection.
I read a book about the Day of Resurrection.
example.bs: Pročitao sam knjigu o Danu proživljenja.

example.en: The right hand is strong.
The student raised the right hand.

critique.note: Unnatural 'raised THE right hand'; use 'رَفَعَ الطَّالِبُ يَمِينَهُ' / 'The student raised his right hand.' / 'Učenik je podigao desnu ruku.'

example.en: The child sat on the right.
example.bs: Dijete je sjelo s desne strane.

example.en: The right side is easier.
The man swore an oath before the judge.

critique.note: Bosnian 'Čovjek se zakleo pred sudijom' drops the target noun (oath), so it does not match the gloss 'zakletvom'/'an oath'. Fix bs: 'Čovjek je položio zakletvu pred sudijom.' (gloss يَمِينًا = 'zakletvu', حَلَفَ = 'položio je').

example.en: The man swore an oath before the judge.
example.bs: Čovjek je položio zakletvu pred sudijom.

example.en: The fathers sat in the garden.
The teacher thanked the fathers.
The principal spoke with the fathers.
The fathers' houses are near.
The nation is strong.
The scholar served the nation.
I read about the ancient nations.
The history of the nation is long.
The neighbors' son is reading a book.
The man visited the neighbors' son.
The child played with the neighbors' son.
example.bs: Dijete se igralo sa sinom komšija.

example.en: The neighbors' son's house is near.
Good deeds gladden the heart.
The child did many good deeds.
The mother was glad of the good deeds.
The trace of good deeds is beautiful.
The truthful person is loved.
People love the truthful person.
The student sat with the truthful.
The speech of a truthful person is clear.
The women are at the market.
The teacher thanked the women.
The doctor spoke with the women.
The women's market is large.
The misdeed is small.
The man gave up misdeeds.
The child regretted the misdeed.
The trace of a misdeed is ugly.
The warner came to the village.
The people heard the warner.
The men listened to the warner.
The warner's voice is strong.
The village is small.
The students visited a beautiful village.
The grandfather lives in the village.
The people of the village are generous.
The daytime is long in summer.
The farmer loves the daytime.
The farmer works in the daytime.
The light of day is beautiful.
The witness spoke before the judge.

critique.note: In MSA الشَّهِيدُ is read as 'the martyr'; 'the martyr spoke before the judge' is misleading. Use the witness sense in an unambiguous frame or pick another sentence; avoid courtroom 'witness' with الشهيد

example.en: The judge asked for two witnesses.

critique.note: 'طَلَبَ ... شَهِيدَيْنِ' echoes Quran 2:282 (وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ), and in MSA شهيد reads as 'martyr'; rewrite with an unambiguous, non-Quranic frame

example.en: The judge listened to the witness.

critique.note: In MSA الشَّهِيدِ reads as 'the martyr' ('the judge listened to the martyr'); courtroom witness is شَاهِد in modern Arabic. Rewrite so the witness sense is unambiguous

example.en: The witness's words are true.

critique.note: In MSA كَلَامُ الشَّهِيدِ reads as 'the martyr's words'; rewrite so the witness sense is unambiguous (modern witness = شَاهِد)

example.en: The witness to the sale is truthful.
The judge questioned the witness to the sale.
The judge trusted the witness to the sale.
The words of the witness to the sale are clear.
The child is playing with the ball.
The mother carried the child.
The father went with the children.
The child's name is beautiful.
Livelihood is scarce this year.
The man found a livelihood in the city.
example.bs: Čovjek je našao opskrbu u gradu.

example.en: The farmer was glad of the livelihood.
The source of livelihood is work.
The deadline is near.
The teacher set a deadline for the work.
example.bs: Učitelj je odredio rok za rad.

example.en: The student finished the work within the deadline.
example.bs: Učenik je završio rad u roku.

example.en: The end of the term is near.
Creation is the topic of the book.
I read a book about the creation of man.
example.bs: Pročitao sam knjigu o stvaranju čovjeka.

example.en: The beginning of creation is the topic of the lesson.
The criminal escaped from prison.
The policeman caught the criminal.
The judge sentenced the criminal.
The criminal's name is known.
Evil is ugly.
People do not love evil.
The child kept away from evil.
The consequence of evil is ugly.
The enemy fled.
The soldier saw the enemy.
The man became a friend to the enemy.
The enemy's army is large.
Death is certain.

critique.note: en 'Death is certain' vs bs 'Smrt je istina' do not match; also gloss حَقٌّ=truth. Use bs 'Smrt je neizbježna.' with en 'Death is certain.' (or en 'Death is a truth.')

example.en: The brave man is not afraid of death.
example.bs: Hrabar čovjek se ne boji smrti.

example.en: People grieved over the grandfather's death.
example.bs: Ljudi su tugovali zbog djedove smrti.

example.en: The cause of death is unknown.

critique.note: Content: 'The cause of death is unknown' has a forensic/crime tone, not gentle for all ages; use e.g. 'ذِكْرُ الْمَوْتِ يُلَيِّنُ الْقَلْبَ' / 'Remembering death softens the heart.' / 'Sjećanje na smrt omekšava srce.'

example.en: Death is certain.

critique.note: الْمَوْتُ حَقٌّ is a well-known religious formula (content policy) and a heavy theme for all ages; حَقٌّ means 'true/a reality', so 'certain/neizbježna' is interpretive. Fix with gentle nature content, e.g. مَوْتُ الْأَزْهَارِ فِي الشِّتَاءِ طَبِيعِيٌّ / 'The death of flowers in winter is natural.' / 'Odumiranje cvijeća zimi je prirodno.' (or 'Smrt cvijeća zimi je prirodna.').

example.en: The cause of the tree's death is thirst.
The death of flowers in winter is natural.
The blessing is great.
The man was thankful for the blessing.
example.bs: Čovjek je bio zahvalan na blagodati.

example.en: The children were glad of the blessing.
Gratitude for a blessing is a duty.
The unseen is unknown.
The doctor does not know the unseen.
The grandfather spoke about the unseen.
The pious sat in the mosque.
The grandfather visited the pious.
I sat with the pious.
The houses of the pious are clean.
